technical-summary: Added explicit architecture coverage reports with required, observed, validated, and per-architecture evidence fields. Optimized validated claims now require complete explicit coverage and fail closed for missing or unvalidated required architectures; legacy flat architecture maps remain valid for inventory diagnostics.
user-summary-candidate: Hardened HI59 release validation so optimized claims cannot overstate architecture support, while preserving inventory-only diagnostics.

technical-summary: Added production manifest validation requiring every non-native candidate to carry a reference path, finite error metrics, tolerances, and exact signature/build namespace binding; native-only inventory profiles remain exempt. Added HI16 and HI26 regression coverage.
user-summary-candidate: Bound production candidate correctness evidence to immutable reference artifacts and matching build/signature namespaces while preserving native-only diagnostics.
